mapper.insert: INSERT INTO oripa_place (place_id, summary, introduction, social_links) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{summary}, #{introduction}, #{socialLinks}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE summary = VALUES(summary), introduction = VALUES(introduction), social_links = VALUES(social_links)
INSERT INTO oripa_place_images (place_id, image_key, sort_order) VALUES (#{placeId}, #{imageKey}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE oripa_place_images SET sort_order = #{sortOrder} WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM oripa_place_images WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, (SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1) AS imageUrl FROM places p WHERE p.id = #{id}
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.category FROM tags t INNER JOIN place_tags pt ON pt.tag_id = t.id WHERE pt.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY t.id ASC
SELECT id FROM places WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT place_id, summary, introduction, social_links FROM oripa_place WHERE place_id = #{placeId}

SELECT p.id, p.type, p.name, p.branch_name AS branchName, p.address, p.location_detail AS locationDetail, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.business_hours AS businessHours, p.holiday_info AS holidayInfo, p.phone, p.description,
( SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl
FROM places p ORDER BY p.id

SELECT p.id, p.type, p.name, p.branch_name AS branchName, p.address, p.location_detail AS locationDetail, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.business_hours AS businessHours, p.holiday_info AS holidayInfo, p.phone, p.description, ( SELECT pi.image_url FROM place_images pi WHERE pi.place_id = p.id ORDER BY pi.sort_order ASC, pi.id ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS imageUrl FROM places p WHERE p.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.branch_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 10
